name: menubar-49
description: Checkout flow menubar with a Cart menu summarizing items and a Shipping speed radio that updates the total.

Cart (2) Linen throw blanket{" "} $96 Stoneware mug set{" "} $52 Edit cart Shipping {Object.entries(speeds).map(([value, s]) => ( {s.label} {s.price ? "$" + s.price : "Free"} ))}
Total {"$" + (subtotal + speeds[speed]!.price) + ".00"}
) }
